reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their correction in #central-team, confirming that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

Pree's earlier message and my thread reply to it still say Dock 23. I can't edit messages, so I suggested they correct or annotate the original so nobody uses the old site. As before, I didn't save this to long-term memory, because that memory comes up in conversations with every member.
